notes.title: Valentines Day Sale and Major Update
notes.notes:
Happy Valentines day! To celebrate this occasion we have 30% off Zunius in a Steam sale. Your and your boo can enjoy the new major Zunius Update. 

Features include
[list]
[*]HARD MODE now available
[*]Several new achievements that unlock secrets
[*]Multiple new powerups
[*]Several new enemies
[*]Can see which ships you’ve completed game with
[*]Challenges no longer give you unfair items
[*]Blackhole powerup does right thing on final level
[*]Ship looks more beautiful
[*]Multiple improvements to start from seed
[/list]

notes.title: Zunius Update Coming Soon
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce a major Zunius update is coming on the most Zunius-y day of the year - Valentines Day! On 14th February you and your sugar baby can play a major Zunius update including
[list]
[*] A brand new Hard mode
[*] New achievements, power ups, enemies and more
[/list]

We'll be sending out the full release details closer to the day. Thats all for now

notes.title: Furious Velociraptor Release
notes.notes: Certain powerups had an exceedingly small chance of appearing. These powerups now have a much greater chance of appearing during gameplay.

notes.title: Screaming Grasshopper Release
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] The release names are getting boring so switching to code names
[*] Enemy bullets are now much clearer
[*] Enhanced storyline
[*] Coins last longer
[*] UI has been polished
[*] Screen resolution detection on startup more robust
[*] Switched to OpenGL core
[/list]

notes.title: 0.0.1.35 Release
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Fixed Windows 7 Problems
[*]Trilinear filtering now works again and is enabled by default
[*]Much better controller support
[*]Skipped three patch numbers to keep you on your toes
[/list]

notes.title: 0.0.1.32 Release
notes.notes: Death blackholes now lead to more challenges...

notes.title: 0.0.1.31 Release
notes.notes:
Graphics settings now have more options including
[list]
[*] Anti aliasing on / off
[*] Color grading on / off
[*] Configurable texture filtering
[/list]

Trilinear filtering was causing some issues so has been turned off for now (will be turned back on before release)

notes.title: 0.0.1.30 Release
notes.notes:
Much improved artwork in general including

[list]
[*] Better powerup icons
[*]Robot crab
[*]More beautiful flowers
[/list]

Art is now optimized for 4k resolution
